newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates dip in most maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates dip in most maturities.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) dipped in most maturities on Friday, with only the one year term unchanged, traders said.
Traders said the decline in rates was in line with the trend at the overnight money market.

Banks also anticipate interest rates will slide in the longer-term with the two-step lowering of reserve requirements, dealers said. A one percentage-point cut was implemented on Friday and another cut is scheduled on July 4.
PHIBOR quotes represents the rates banks are willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
